quality.note: The complete local suite ran before the final v1 text-anchor/layer-order and history-navigation extensions; all units and all seven updated Canvas flows passed after those extensions. Final CI checks the pushed commit and reruns the complete suite.

performance.note: Wall-clock automated interaction durations, including input/DOM assertion and autosave debounce for import. Not FPS or a large-document guarantee.

gates.A: drag creation, direct text, styles, ink and sketch
gates.B: selection/Shift, movement, resize, duplicate/delete/layers/history, anchored/free connectors
gates.C: manual three-level hierarchy, direct/portal, Escape/reduced motion, saved cameras, cycles and orphan recovery/deletion
gates.D: v1/v2 migration and hostile parser, actual IDB reload, projects, JSON/PNG, quota rescue/retry and stale-tab rejection
gates.E: 27 lazy static entries, unchanged previous 26 slugs, responsive/touch/keyboard/performance and complete regression suite

P2: Screen-reader certification and Firefox/WebKit parity not performed
Advanced touch/pen, routing, rotation, grouping and collaborative editing are outside this RC
Only representative board timing measured; no FPS, 50k-shape or long-session heap guarantee

recommendation: GO as a release candidate on the isolated branch. No merge to main. Exact final CI and Cloudflare deployment are checked after push; no production audit is claimed.
